== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns John Glasco, charged at Bow Street. John Glasco, Esq., said he was an officer on the Staff and was brought before the Bow Street magistrate charged with wounding patrolman John Smith. The reported incident occurred on Tuesday night after the play in Covent Garden; Glasco was committed.<ref>The Times, 2 May 1799, p.3, Public Office, Bow Street; [https://www.newspapers.com/image/32820363/ record].</ref> Allegation and committal are not conviction. Military status is self-reported and unconfirmed; no Irish origin or kin is stated. The identification remains uncertain.
